Which are the best Shapoorji Pallonji projects in Pune for 2026?

The top-rated Shapoorji Pallonji projects in Pune for 2026 include Joyville Sensorium (Hinjewadi), Joyville Hadapsar Annexe, and Vanaha (Bavdhan). These projects offer Mivan technology construction and EDGE certification.

What is the price of 2 BHK flats in Hinjewadi Phase 1 by Joyville?

Joyville Vyomora in Hinjewadi Phase 1 offers premium 2 BHK apartments starting from ₹84.99 Lakhs, while Joyville Sensorium provides luxury biophilic 2 BHKs from ₹1.10 Cr onwards.

Is Joyville Hadapsar Annexe ready to move?

Yes, Joyville Hadapsar Annexe offers both ready-to-move options in completed phases and under-construction units in newly launched towers like Joyville Celestia.

What are the benefits of Mivan technology in Shapoorji projects?

Shapoorji Pallonji uses Mivan (monolithic) technology to ensure leak-proof structures, higher carpet area efficiency, and superior earthquake resistance compared to traditional brickwork.
